install.note: Use the official public npm package cline. It selects a native binary for Windows, macOS or Linux, x64 or ARM64. npm is needed for installation; the binary bundles its runtime. Installing the CLI does not install the Cline desktop application or an IDE extension.

first_run.note: Use cline auth for native account login if requested. EchoBird handles API model configuration. Desktop and CLI share native provider settings; applying a model in EchoBird synchronizes their defaults. Existing sessions retain their own model. Open Desktop once before switching it; explicit apply closes a running Desktop to update its stored selection. CLINE_PROVIDER_SETTINGS_PATH overrides the provider file, followed by CLINE_DATA_DIR, then CLINE_DIR/data, then ~/.cline/data. Preserve unrelated providers and credentials.

identity_guard.description: Cline CLI is the terminal client (command cline). Cline Desktop is a separate native application (cline-app), not installed by npm install -g cline. Ask Desktop or CLI only when the requested edition is ambiguous.
